newsitem.title: USA: Dayton Hudson to sell four Texas stores.
newsitem.headline: Dayton Hudson to sell four Texas stores.

text.p: Dayton Hudson Corp said on Wednesday that it has entered agreements to sell its four Marshall Field's stores in Texas.

The agreements call for the San Antonio store to be purchased by Federated Department Stores Inc and operated by its Macy's West division and the Dallas Galleria, Houston Galleria and Houston Town & Country stores will be purchased by Saks Holdings Inc's Saks Fifth Avenue, Dayton Hudson said. Both agreements are subject to typical contingencies, the retailer said.
Terms of the sales were not disclosed.

"The sale of our four Texas Marshall Field's stores allows the department store division to focus its resources in its core Midwest markets where we have a strong presence," said Bob Ulrich, chairman and chief executive officer of Dayton Hudson, in a statement. "We remain committed to the department store division."

Most Marshall Field's employees working at the San Antonio store as of the closing date will be offered employment with Macy's West, Dayton Hudson said. Marshall Field's employees working at the Dallas Galleria, Houston Galleria and Houston Town & Country stores will have the opportunity to interview for positions with Saks, Dayton Hudson said.
Dayton's operates 19 stores in four states. Hudson's operates 22 stores in three states and Marshall Field's currently operates 26 stores in four states.
